newsitem.title: USA: Hershey closes $330 mln deal with Huhtamaki.
newsitem.headline: Hershey closes $330 mln deal with Huhtamaki.

text.p: Hershey Foods Corp said Monday it had completed the purchase of Huhtamaki Oy's confectionery operations in North America.

Hershey said the purchase of the Huhtamaki's Leaf operations was worth about $330 million after taking into account the Helsinki, Finland company's purchase of its European confectionery interests in Germany and Italy.

It said it had also entered into a licensing arrangement under which Hershey will manufacture, market and distribute Leaf's North American confectionery brands including Jolly Rancher, Whoppers, Good & Plenty, PayDay, Heath and Milk Duds, and Xylifresh gum.
